title: Machine Setup
connectDesc: Make sure the machine is connected and ready
connectFirst: Connect the machine from the connection icon in the top menu
originXYDesc: Move to where the job should start and set the zero point
heightZDesc: Lower Z slowly until the tool touches the material surface
zWarning: Use small increments (0.1mm) near the material
focusDesc: Adjust Z height to find the laser focal point
focusInstruction: Move Z up and down until the laser dot is the smallest and sharpest possible
focusWarning: The laser is at low power but avoid looking directly at the dot
dryRunDesc: Verify the work area is correct before starting
dryRunCNCDesc: The machine will trace the job perimeter at safe height, without lowering the tool
dryRunLaserDesc: The laser will trace the perimeter at minimum power to show the area without burning
noElements: No elements on canvas to calculate the area
usingWorkArea: No canvas elements — using full work area bounds
readyDesc: The machine is calibrated and ready to work
